capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Wikipedia infobox 93.4 kWh; Audi says 93 kWh gross (2022-2024).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Audi: "84 kWh of energy net (93 kWh gross)"; Wikipedia 84.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: The Weekly Driver lists the Audi e-tron GT 2022-2024 on the 93.4 kWh J1 pack: NMC, LG Energy Solution. Third-party page, not an Audi statement.

preconditioning.notes: Audi 2021 winter release: with a destination set, the e-tron route planner activates battery preconditioning while driving (e-tron GT). No manual control described.

dc_max_kw.notes: Audi: peak charging capacity up to 270 kW at an 800 V DC terminal (2022-2024 e-tron GT quattro and RS).

ac_max_kw.notes: Audi European launch page: 11 kW AC standard (22 kW option announced). No US/Canada page found; the US onboard charger on e-tron and Q6 is 9.6 kW per Wikipedia/Cars.com, so a US/CA figure of 9.6 kW is possible. Not verified for North America.
